entities.name: Rayne
entities.description: Chancellor of the Tolarian Academy, wife of Barrin and mother of Hanna, killed by Greel.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: Academy on Dominaria where Rayne was chancellor.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Leader at the Academy whose plans Rayne often opposed.

entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: Ally with whom Rayne led successful missions.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian whose death cloud briefly turned Rayne undead.

events.summary: Rayne was brought to the Tolarian Academy and caught Barrin's attention.
events.quote: she immediately caught the attention of her future husband, Barrin.

events.summary: Rayne was killed by Greel during the Prophecy War.
events.quote: Battered and broken, she was unable to defend herself against the mutant warrior Greel , who swiftly ended her life.

events.summary: Rayne, Barrin and Hanna were briefly turned undead by Yawgmoth's death cloud.
events.quote: Rayne, Barrin and Hanna were all briefly turned into undead

relations.quote: She was killed by Greel during the Keldon invasion of Jamuraa .
